summary: Validated Android Gradle wrapper/tooling setup and reran backend/admin regression suite. Wrapper files are present and correctly configured for Gradle 8.10.2 with AGP 8.7.3. Build verification is blocked by missing Java/Android SDK only, not missing wrapper artifacts.
action_items: Install JDK 17 and Android SDK API 35 in CI/workspace to execute full :app:assembleDebug.
Set NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL in runtime/CI environment so API-contract tests never skip in fresh environments.
critical_code_review_comments: No blocking implementation defects found in Android wrapper/tooling files under current scope.
Workspace does not contain frontend/.env with REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL; project currently uses admin-web/NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL conventions.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Android wrapper exists (gradlew, gradlew.bat, wrapper jar/properties), gradlew and verify script are executable, distributionUrl is gradle-8.10.2-bin.zip, and android/build.gradle.kts pins com.android.application version 8.7.3. verify-android-build.sh fails fast on missing Java; with Java shim it fails next on missing Android SDK, confirming expected prerequisite gating.
rca of the issue: Build verification cannot complete in this container because required host tooling is absent: first failure is Java command missing; once Java is simulated, script reaches and fails at missing ANDROID_HOME/ANDROID_SDK_ROOT. No evidence of wrapper file absence or wrapper misconfiguration.
